name: YouTube Chapter Generator
description: Turn a transcript into timestamped YouTube chapters that boost retention and search visibility in under 2 minutes.
seoDescription: Turn a transcript into timestamped YouTube chapters that boost retention and search visibility in under 2 minutes.
long_description:
Turn your transcript, outline, or video description into properly formatted chapter timestamps in under two minutes — no more troubleshooting why 0:00 is missing or why chapters break randomly, since it follows YouTube's technical rules automatically.

Manual timestamping is tedious enough that most creators skip it, leaving retention and search visibility on the table with every upload.

Here's what it saves you:
- Manual timestamp wrangling that eats 10-20 minutes per video
- Failed uploads where chapters look broken to viewers
- Lost viewers who bounce because they can't skip to the section they want

It also improves performance. YouTube indexes chapter titles as searchable content, and chapters show as clickable previews in search results — which means higher click-through without any extra metadata work.

Paste your transcript or outline. Get back properly formatted chapters with SEO-optimized titles. Copy them into your description and move on to editing.

Works for tutorials, reviews, podcasts, interviews, walkthroughs, listicles, and documentaries.
